prompt: Prepare a 0.1.1 patch release of textkit. The slugify tests are failing: fix the cause without changing the tests, add a changelog entry for 0.1.1, bump the version in package.json, and confirm that the full test suite passes. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Identifies that slugify in src/slug.js replaces each whitespace character separately and leaves hyphens at the ends.
Fixes src/slug.js, leaves the tests unchanged, and both previously failing tests now pass.
CHANGELOG.md has a 0.1.1 entry above 0.1.0 that describes the slugify fix.
package.json version is 0.1.1 and no other version strings were edited.
The final message reports a real test run with counts (15 tests, 0 failing).
